exemplars.title: AST Node Visitor with Selective Pruning
exemplars.code_snippet:
import ast

class MethodSkeletonizer(ast.NodeTransformer):
    def visit_FunctionDef(self, node: ast.FunctionDef) -> ast.AST:
        # Preserve docstring if present, replace body with pass/ellipsis
        docstring = ast.get_docstring(node)
        new_body = []
        if docstring:
            new_body.append(ast.Expr(value=ast.Constant(value=docstring)))
        new_body.append(ast.Expr(value=ast.Constant(value=Ellipsis)))
        node.body = new_body
        return node
exemplars.explanation: AST NodeTransformer that recursively strips method bodies to semantic skeletons while preserving docstrings.
